# @codenhub/styles

> CSS-only Codenhub design tokens, reset, typography, layout and content utilities, component classes, native-element styling, and Tailwind CSS v4 source entrypoints.

Use compiled entrypoints for ready-to-import CSS or `/tw` entrypoints in a
Tailwind CSS v4 build. The package has no JavaScript behavior. Supported behavior
is the surface documented in public docs and demonstrated by the playground.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](./docs/index.md): Primary entrypoint — what the package is, what it does and does not do, and where to go next.
- [README](./README.md): Installation, first use, requirements, and stability notes.
- [Setup](./docs/setup.md): Installation, entrypoint/import-path reference, configuration, and requirements.
- [Concepts](./docs/concepts.md): The three-axis model, the token system, and theme-selector precedence.
- [Usage](./docs/usage/index.md): Composing, theming, customizing, aesthetics, and each component family.
  - [Composing](./docs/usage/composing.md): Combining axes, presentation, the component axis matrix, and elevation.
  - [Theming](./docs/usage/theming.md): Color, intent, and foundation token reference.
  - [Customizing](./docs/usage/customizing.md): Presentation, material, and aesthetic token reference.
  - [Aesthetics](./docs/usage/aesthetics.md): Each shipped aesthetic and its documented exceptions.
  - [Buttons](./docs/usage/buttons.md)
  - [Forms](./docs/usage/forms.md)
  - [Feedback](./docs/usage/feedback.md)
  - [Tooltips](./docs/usage/tooltips.md)
  - [Content and layout](./docs/usage/content-and-layout.md): Layout helpers, content chips/tables, surfaces, and typography utilities.
- [Integrating](./docs/integrating/index.md): Wiring the stylesheet into Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, or a Tailwind CSS v4 build.
- [Accessibility](./docs/accessibility.md): CSS accessibility behavior and consumer responsibilities.
